topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: It's a rainy night, and I've just heard the old Reliable Café is shutting its doors. You'd think they'd serve some decent coffee, at least, to last you through the years. But nothing's forever in this town. I've seen better joints than this one crumble to dust. Still, there's a part of me that'll miss the clinking of mugs and the way the steam rises up like forgotten memories. I guess tomorrow, I'll have to find a new spot to nurse my coffee and my thoughts. But that's life, always pushing you from one corner to the next.
